integrity: The proof reconstructs all allowed assignments and color-multiset conditions. Direct exhaustive software tests agree; external independent validation has not been performed. Prior scalar chromatic results and definitions are credited.
scientific_limitations: Counts full-vertex labeled proper conflict-free open-neighborhood colorings only for crown graphs with \(n\ge3\), with any nonnegative integer color palette; no general graph counting-complexity assertion. Finite checks are corroborative.
title: Proper conflict-free coloring polynomial of crown graphs
